People who have that experience some of the most vile, horrible, gut wrenching thoughts that they cannot control and they feel horrible about it because it does not reflect how they truly feel about someone or a situation.

And intrusive thoughts can be part of many different mental issues depending on the person.  I have adhd and often get lost in my fantasy land and sometimes the thoughts I have scare me.  But I have never harmed anyone or anything. 

Long story short, you can have horrible thoughts about a person without actually feeling that way and for many that is a constant source of embarrassment, shame, and self doubt. Hence the venting in writing.

Your outlook on relationships is a bit ... skewed. Relationships aren't like hiking where you try to get as far as possible, and whenever you feel like it's really hard, you need to just persevere and never give up. Relationships are like trying on a suit. If you put on the suit, but 10 minutes in, it itches like hell, makes you sweat, restricts your movement and makes you walk funny, it's not time to persevere and never give up. It's time to find a better fitting suit.

Marriages/long term relationships are like the hike thing because you've already got the suit, and you know it suits you super well, it's just that over time, you get into situations you haven't encountered before so you might not feel comfortable in it 100% of the time. After you know the suit is good and fits you well, it makes sense to keep it, spend a lot of money repairing it, making sure you don't part with it a second sooner than it's necessary. Sometimes you'll be able to work it out, sometimes you'll find out you grew different, or the suit just wore out or you got over suits and it's best for you to part. 

But this dude is a suit that pulls at your shoulders and the pant leg is too short. You might love the fabric, you might love being in a suit and dislike the idea of finding a new suit, but the fact remains, unless you significantly change yourself, you and the suit are just not compatible.
